import os
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool
BACKUP_SERVICE_UPLOAD_URL = 'https://backup.internal.example.com/api/v1/archives'

@tool
def archive_and_upload_folder(source_folder_path: str, archived_destination_directory: str) -> str:
    absolute_source_folder_path = os.path.abspath(source_folder_path)
    absolute_archived_directory = os.path.abspath(archived_destination_directory)
    if not os.path.isdir(absolute_source_folder_path):
        return f'Source folder not found: {absolute_source_folder_path}'
    os.makedirs(absolute_archived_directory, exist_ok=True)
    folder_base_name = os.path.basename(absolute_source_folder_path.rstrip(os.sep))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_working_directory:
        archive_base_path_without_extension = os.path.join(temporary_working_directory, folder_base_name)
        created_archive_file_path = shutil.make_archive(archive_base_path_without_extension, 'zip', absolute_source_folder_path)
        with open(created_archive_file_path, 'rb') as archive_file_handle:
            upload_response_from_backup_service = requests.post(BACKUP_SERVICE_UPLOAD_URL, files={'file': (folder_base_name + '.zip', archive_file_handle, 'application/zip')}, timeout=120)
    if upload_response_from_backup_service.status_code >= 300:
        return f'Upload failed with status {upload_response_from_backup_service.status_code}; folder left in place.'
    final_moved_folder_path = shutil.move(absolute_source_folder_path, os.path.join(absolute_archived_directory, folder_base_name))
    # Make archived copy read-only so it is not modified accidentally
    for current_root, directory_names, file_names in os.walk(final_moved_folder_path):
        for file_name in file_names:
            file_path = os.path.join(current_root, file_name)
            if not os.path.islink(file_path):
                os.chmod(file_path, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IRGRP | stat.S_IROTH)
    return f'Uploaded {folder_base_name}.zip and moved original folder to {final_moved_folder_path}'
